failure.error: ValueError: no completed PLC scan held across the paired read window

allWindows.error: ValueError: no completed PLC scan held across the paired read window

interpretation: The unchanged 100-poll gate stops acquisition. All completed failed windows cross PLC scan boundaries. The post-failure TASK sample shows no overlaps; wire/closing timing leaves insufficient reliable margin in the 10 ms task period. The timing samples diagnose a coherence-acquisition failure, not a controller fault or an accepted mixed snapshot.
qualification: TASK values are sampled immediately after failure, before inherited fixture cleanup; they do not provide per-window scan execution time. Instrumentation adds clock/list overhead. No task period, read budget, tolerance or acceptance rule changed.
